name: Fake Online Stores
what: Sellers advertise cheap trendy goods online, take payment, then never ship anything.
do: Do not buy; check trusted retailers only

name: Fake Jobs and Tasks
what: Scammers offer easy remote work then demand fees or deposits to continue earning.
spot: Paid to like videos or rate hotels
Asked to pay deposit or training
do: Never pay to get a job

name: Fake Crypto Investments
what: Fake advisors show growing profits to lure bigger deposits, then block withdrawals.
spot: Guaranteed high returns with no risk
Must pay fee to withdraw funds
do: Do not invest; verify with licensed broker

name: Romance and Sugar Scams
what: Someone builds love or sugar relationship then asks money, checks, or fees.
spot: Quick love or generous allowance promise
Never meets in person or video
Requests gift cards checks or fees
do: Never send money to online lover

name: Bank Fraud Calls
what: Callers pretend to be your bank warning of fraud to steal codes and transfers.
spot: Asks for OTPs passwords or transfers
Spoofed caller ID or callback pressure
do: Hang up; call bank number yourself

name: Official Threat Calls
what: Callers pose as police, courts, or collectors threatening arrest unless you pay.
spot: Threat of arrest lawsuit or warrant
Demands gift cards wire or crypto
No written proof or case details
do: Hang up; verify with official agency directly

name: Delivery Fee Texts
what: Texts claim unpaid parcel, customs, traffic, or toll fee with malicious payment link.
do: Do not click; check official site directly

name: Wrong Number Texts
what: Stranger texts wrong number then befriends you to pitch jobs or investments.
do: Do not reply; block and report

name: Fake Sellers and Rentals
what: Listings offer tickets, pets, cars, or rentals cheaply then vanish after deposit.
do: Never pay before seeing in person

name: Fake Check Overpayments
what: Someone sends extra check or payment then asks you to refund the difference.
do: Wait for bank clearance; never refund

name: Gift Card Requests
what: Boss, family, or celebrity urgently asks you to buy gift cards for them.
do: Verify by calling person directly

name: Prize and Freebie Scams
what: You supposedly won a prize or gift but must pay shipping or fees first.
spot: Fee to claim prize or gift
do: Never pay to claim prizes

name: Sextortion Scams
what: Someone threatens to share intimate images or videos unless you pay.
spot: Contact from stranger or hacked account
do: Do not pay; save evidence report

name: Violent Extortion Threats
what: Criminals threaten harm, kidnapping, or exposure claiming cartel or police connection.
do: Stay safe; call police immediately

name: Phishing and Account Theft
what: Fake emails, texts, or support agents trick you into sharing codes or access.
spot: Link to verify account or order
Asks for OTP password or access
do: Never share codes; open official app

name: Advance Fee Scams
what: Promised inheritance, loan, grant, or payout requires upfront fees to release.
do: Never pay upfront for promised money

name: Mule Reshipping Scams
what: Job asks you to receive, forward, or deposit packages or money for others.
spot: Paid to forward parcels or cash
do: Refuse; you carry legal risk

name: Family Emergency Scams
what: Caller claims loved one crashed, arrested, or stranded and needs money now.
do: Hang up; call family directly

name: Fake Charity Pleas
what: Fake charities solicit donations for disasters, illness, or causes that vanish.
do: Donate only via verified charities

name: Gambling and Betting Scams
what: Tipsters or casinos promise sure wins but rig games or demand withdrawal fees.
do: Do not deposit; leave site

name: Other Mixed Scams
what: Unclear or unusual reports that do not fit common scam patterns above.
spot: Odd request for money or info
do: Pause; ask trusted person first
